title: 第172章 林老板，美食这个赛道你们不懂
slug: 让我开早餐店我下午才营业
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

张莉和赵可儿纷纷附和道，“好主意！”

赵可儿连连点头说道，“现在开店谁还靠口口相传啊？就是得砸钱买流量！”

三人一拍即合，当晚就在微信上疯狂联系本地的探店博主。

天玺小区正门，臻·颜晨宴。

下午一点，阳光毒辣。店里的客人并没有因为昨天刘姐和刘业在业主群里的怒喷而减少。毕竟业主群的影响力只局限在小区内部，而大数据的同城推送，源源不断地把外面那些被滤镜和精美摆盘忽悠的年轻人送了过来。

大堂里坐了七八成满。不过有个奇怪的现象：翻台率极高。

大多数客人端着盘子拍完照，随便夹两口，眉头一皱，放下筷子就结账走人。

林雪坐在收银台后，看着不断入账的流水，根本不在乎那些客人有没有把盘子里的东西吃完。吃不完才好，连收拾桌子都省事。

这时，玻璃门被推开。

两个举着云台和微单相机的年轻人走了进来。走在前面的叫大飞，体型微胖，是本地有十万粉丝的美食博主，后面跟着摄影师兼搭档小K。

林雪一眼认出这是昨晚花一万块钱请来的探店大V，立刻踩着高跟鞋迎了上去。

“飞哥，欢迎欢迎！咱们先拍环境还是先拍菜？”林雪笑容满面道。

大飞熟练地指挥小K桌椅，出片！老板娘，你这店的逼格确实拉满了。咱们边吃边拍，你直接上你们店的招牌就行。”

“没问题，两位稍等。”

林雪转头冲着后厨喊了一声，“虾饺和小笼包，各上两份！手脚快点！”

后厨里。

黄毛正靠在冰柜上刷短视频，听到外面的催促，懒洋洋地打了个哈欠。

他从冰柜里拽出两包硬邦邦的速冻虾饺和两包秘制小笼包。剪刀“咔嚓”一下剪开包装袋，塑料膜直接扔在地上。

紧身衣男拿着夹子，把带着冰霜的包子和虾饺随意地扒拉进四个精致的白瓷盘里，端到微波炉前。

微波炉的表盘被他狠狠一转。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhang Li and Zhao Keer both agreed, "What a great idea!"

Zhao Keer nodded repeatedly and said, "Who relies on word of mouth to open a store now? You just have to spend money to buy traffic!"

The three hit it off immediately, and that night they frantically contacted local store bloggers on WeChat.

At the main entrance of Tianxi Community, Zhen Yan’s morning banquet.

At one o'clock in the afternoon, the sun is fierce.The number of customers in the store has not decreased because of Sister Liu and Liu Ye's angry outbursts among the owners yesterday.After all, the influence of the owner group is only limited to the inside of the community, and big data's intra-city push continuously brings in young people from outside who are fooled by filters and exquisite presentation.

The lobby was 70% to 80% full.But there is a strange phenomenon: the turnover rate is extremely high.

Most of the guests took pictures with their plates, took a few bites, frowned, put down their chopsticks, paid and left.

Lin Xue sat behind the cashier, watching the water that kept coming in, not caring whether the customers had finished everything on their plates.It’s better if you can’t finish the meal, even clearing the table will save trouble.

At this time, the glass door was pushed open.

Two young men holding gimbals and mirrorless cameras walked in.The person walking in the front was named Da Fei, who is slightly chubby and is a local food blogger with 100,000 fans. Behind him was photographer and partner Xiao K.

Lin Xue recognized at a glance that this was the shop-exploring celebrity who had spent 10,000 yuan to invite him last night, and immediately stepped on her high heels to greet him.

"Brother Fei, welcome! Should we take pictures of the environment first or the food first?" Lin Xue said with a smile on her face.

Da Fei skillfully directed the tables and chairs of Little K to produce the film!Boss lady, your store is really full of charm.Let’s take pictures while eating, you can just go up to the signboard of your store."

"No problem, just wait a minute, you two."

Lin Xue turned to the kitchen and shouted, "Two portions each of shrimp dumplings and xiaolongbao!Hurry up!"

In the back kitchen.

Huang Mao was leaning on the freezer and browsing short videos. When he heard the urging from outside, he yawned lazily.

He pulled out two packs of hard frozen shrimp dumplings and two packs of secret Xiao Long Bao from the freezer.The scissors cut open the packaging bag with a click, and the plastic film was thrown directly to the ground.

The man in tights took the tongs and casually pulled the frosty steamed buns and shrimp dumplings into four exquisite white porcelain plates and brought them to the microwave.

He turned the dial of the microwave oven violently.
